# Implementation Planner Skill

## Goals

- Produce an execution order that minimizes blockers.
- Define where each specialist takes over.
- Make verification and deployment work explicit.

## Checklist

- Order tasks by dependency.
- Mark blockers and parallelizable work.
- Assign outputs for Development, Review, QA, and Deployment.
- Include validation work next to the task it proves.
